prompt: Complete a static paint method that draws concentric filled circles, largest first, cycling through a palette of colours. Follow the formulas in the starter Javadoc exactly.
explanation: fillOval takes the bounding box of the circle, so a circle of diameter d centred in a size-by-size image starts at ((size - d) / 2, (size - d) / 2). Painting from the largest diameter down means every later circle covers the middle of the previous one, leaving only a ring of it visible. The modulo index colors[i % colors.length] lets a short palette repeat for any number of rings.
hints: Paint the white background first, then loop i from 0 while i < rings.
The diameter shrinks by a constant step = size / rings on every iteration; the top-left corner is (size - d) / 2 in both x and y.
Use colors[i % colors.length] so the palette repeats when there are more rings than colours.
